input.objective:
Token name: Pupate
Token symbol: PUPATE

Total supply 1,000,000,000 with 18 decimals, minted once to its deployer. Sepolia (chain id 11155111), a Uniswap v4 hook launch paired with native ETH; 85% of supply to the pool.

LAUNCH THIS REPOSITORY AS IT IS. The workspace is a finished, tested and independently reviewed project at the given base commit. The deliverable is the launch of this exact code, not new code: do not rewrite, refactor or reformat it, and do not modify src/, test/, script/, lib/ or foundry.toml. PupateHook is bound by its constructor to two contracts that are already deployed on Sepolia from this same source, so a changed hook would not fit them: the vault Cocoon at 0xff466998add222de5963f9648fc8499a46badc82 (the hook's sink) and an OpenZeppelin TimelockController with a 48-hour delay at 0x780a18072c024ea79b2f4e27da89aaf3b166c5a3 (the hook's owner).

WHAT TO DO. (1) Verify that launch.json is a valid manifest for the launch factory: hook PupateHook with the three-argument constructor ($poolManager, the Cocoon address, the timelock address); permissions afterInitialize, beforeAddLiquidity, beforeSwap, afterSwap, beforeSwapReturnDelta, afterSwapReturnDelta (flags 0x18CC, which the constructor validates against the hook's own address, so the hook needs a mined CREATE2 salt); token PupateToken with a zero-argument constructor; pool fee 12500, tick spacing 60, paired currency native ETH. (2) Run the existing test suite (forge test; the suites under test/fork run only when MAINNET_RPC_URL is set and skip themselves otherwise) and report the result. (3) Review the code as it is and report findings; if you find a defect, report it with a reproducing test instead of changing the source.

KEEP THESE FACTS UNCHANGED. PupateToken is a plain ERC-20: no owner, mint, pause, fee, transfer limit or blacklist; burn and burnFrom only reduce supply. PupateHook taxes the ETH side of every swap in its launch pool, which is the first native-ETH pool initialised on it; swaps whose sender is the sink are not taxed (the vault's own buybacks). Sells pay the standing tax of 6%. Buys pay 99% when the pool opens, falling by one percentage point a minute until it meets the standing tax about 93 minutes later. The tax is collected inside the swap as ERC-6909 claims on the PoolManager; no ETH moves and no contract other than the PoolManager is called from a swap callback. A taxed swap that names its ETH amount and cannot fill in full reverts (PartialFill). flush() is permissionless and hands the hook's whole ETH balance to Cocoon.depositTax. The owner can only lower the standing tax and transfer ownership; nothing can raise the tax, change the sink or change the launch pool.

LIQUIDITY. beforeAddLiquidity admits liquidity only into the launch pool and only in the transaction that initialises it: afterInitialize sets a mark in transient storage (EIP-1153), which the EVM clears when that transaction ends. The launch factory's deploy, initialise and seed transaction passes; every later transaction is refused, in the same block as well, and after the launch the pool's liquidity can only shrink. Removing liquidity and collecting fees are never gated. Known residual, kept on purpose and pinned by test_theOpeningTransactionIsTheGateNotTheAccountThatOpens: the mark names no account, so code that gets control later inside the opening transaction could add liquidity too; after it initialises the pool, the launch factory calls only the PoolManager, the launched token and its own registry in that transaction. test/fork/LaunchFactory.fork.t.sol rehearses this launch through the real launch factory on a mainnet fork. Every test opens and seeds its pool in one call, so none depends on how a forge version scopes transient storage between top-level calls; the suite passes on forge 1.7.1 and on forge 1.8.3, in default and --isolate modes.

CONTEXT. Cocoon, FloorFeed and PupateVesting are in src/ for review and are not deployed by this launch. Cocoon and FloorFeed are already deployed and are owned by the launch wallet until the launch: right after it, script/PostLaunch.s.sol wires the vault to the new pool (that needs the token and hook addresses), moves the wallet's 5% of supply into a 12-month linear vesting contract, pins the oracle question, and transfers both contracts to the timelock. This is a rehearsal of the mainnet launch: the collection, the IMD token and the oracle attester on Sepolia are test stand-ins. The launch factory sets the opening price; launch.json's initialPrice is the policy's 20 ETH valuation of the supply. Three independent reviews are logged in docs/REVIEW.md. Do not claim the code is audited or secure.
